items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4(b) and 7.1.9 cover the fractured internal valve. Allow €65 gross for one standard like-for-like valve.
Section 7.1.9 covers a connector that must be renewed with the fractured valve, but not a precautionary replacement. Allow €24 gross for one standard hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary repair labour. Allow 3 hours at €92 gross per hour, consistent with the plumbing references.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers consumables actually used in the repair, not the contractor's own tools under 3.6(c). Allow €36 gross for this small repair.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance by the plumber. Allow €83 gross, in line with comparable call-outs.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 cover necessary use of the camera, not its purchase. Allow €145 gross for one diagnostic use; the €2,500 aggregate leak-location cap does not bind on the listed costs.

items.description: Local facade repair after internal water escape
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render damaged when water from the internal escape froze in the wall; optional external frost cover is not needed. Under 7.1.5 and 7.1.12, allow €240 gross only for distinct local repair work not duplicated by later lines.
Sections 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1 cover taking off failed plaster and disposing of covered debris. Allow €90 gross for the local damaged patch, excluding labour billed separately.
Sections 7.1.7(c)–(d) cover a like-for-like base coat on the affected area. Allow €65 gross for base-plaster material, without duplicating substrate preparation or painter labour.
Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require the work to be identified and allocated to the insured damage. If substantiated as a distinct minor repair task rather than an extra fee or duplicate, allow €75 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary preparation and re-forming of the affected substrate. Allow €110 gross for local substrate work distinct from the base plaster and separately billed painter hours.

Sections 7.1.7(d) and 7.1.10 cover only the coats required by a like-for-like finish on the damaged area. Allow €85 gross for ordinary local paint materials, without assuming all four coats are necessary or including separately billed primer and labour.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers drying needed before repairing the wall saturated by the internal escape. Allow €230 gross for a limited local drying operation, rather than whole-building drying.
Section 7.1.7(d) covers primer required by the pre-loss finish system on the affected patch. Allow €35 gross for primer, with application labour accounted for separately.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the affected facade area. Allow 5 hours at €75 gross per hour.

Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require a flat rate to identify covered work; a standalone administrative fee is excluded under 3.6(b). If itemised as one eligible painter attendance, allow €80 gross under 7.1.11.
